label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group, single-arm study in which all enrolled patients receive tofacitinib, with no comparator arm described. The record does mention a “clinical randomized controlled trial,” but the explicit design fields and arm description support an uncontrolled single-arm intervention rather than a placebo-controlled study.
reviewReason: The narrative contains contradictory wording (“randomized controlled trial”) that conflicts with the single-group, allocation NA design, so manual review is prudent even though no placebo comparator is described.
title: Tofacitinib in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
